app.name: ME4 Communication Hub
app.tagline: Hermes CIO · Clones · PI-Agents · Status & Sync

hubStatusAll.description: Shows the status of all registered agents (Hermes CIO, Clones, PI-Agents) in the Communication Hub. Returns online/offline status, heartbeat times, and agent types.

hubSyncPlane.description: Synchronizes with Plane (project management at localhost:8080). Auto-authenticates and returns workspaces, projects, and issues. Optional: workspace_slug and project_id for targeted queries.

params.workspaceSlug: Plane workspace slug (e.g. 'me4'). Leave empty for all.
params.projectId: Plane project ID for issue queries. Leave empty for overview.

hubRegisterAgent.description: Registers a new agent (Hermes Clone, PI-Agent, etc.) in the Communication Hub. Required before heartbeats can be sent.

hubHeartbeat.description: Sends a heartbeat for a registered agent. Keeps the status as online. Should be called every 60-120 seconds.

params.agentId: ID of the agent sending the heartbeat.

hubUnregisterAgent.description: Removes an agent from the registry.

params.agentId: ID of the agent to remove.

hubDashboardUrl.description: Returns the URL of the status dashboard, if it is running.

errors.dashboardNotRunning: Dashboard not running. Start server with --dashboard PORT.
